description: This file defines the ErrorGrain class, a test implementation of an Orleans grain used for testing error handling, logging, and asynchronous behavior within the Orleans framework. It includes methods that simulate errors, delays, and unobserved task exceptions.

classes.name: ErrorGrain
classes.description: A test Orleans grain class that simulates various error scenarios, logging, and asynchronous operations for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to log activation.

methods.name: SetAError
methods.description: Sets a value and throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: SetBError
methods.description: Immediately throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Immediately throws an exception to simulate an error.

methods.name: GetAxBError
methods.description: Overloaded method that throws an exception.

methods.name: LongMethod
methods.description: Sleeps synchronously for a specified time.

methods.name: DelayMethod
methods.description: Logs, increments a counter, and delays asynchronously.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorImmediate
methods.description: Creates an unobserved task exception and returns a fixed result.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorDelayed
methods.description: Creates a delayed unobserved task exception and returns a fixed result.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation2
methods.description: Creates a task with a continuation that throws an exception.

methods.name: UnobservedErrorContinuation3
methods.description: Creates a task with a continuation that throws an exception, using Task.CurrentId.

methods.name: UnobservedIgnoredError
methods.description: Creates a task that throws an exception but is ignored.

methods.name: AddChildren
methods.description: Adds child grains; here it does nothing.

methods.name: ExecuteDelayed
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous delay and verifies context preservation.
